title: Clay to Clay balls
body:
Have you ever gone to collect clay, packed it up to save space, only to find out it wouldn't craft into clay balls? 

Well, this datapack lets you do just that!

## What does it do?
Allows you to convert clay blocks back into clay balls, which is not possible in vanilla Minecraft.

## Why download it?

-Improves inventory management

-Makes clay storage more efficient

-Adds a logical feature missing from the base game

## Important information:

It works perfectly in 1.21.2 and later!

Current version: 26.1 (experimental)

## Installation:

Remember that to install it, you must place the .zip file inside the “datapacks” folder, which is located inside your world folder!

## Support / Bugs:

Report bugs or issues to: izugamer777@gmail.com
